A [[human]] '''individual''' served as a [[medic]] leader for a [[ISB medical team|team]] in the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] as part of the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="MIS" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The medic leader first appeared in the [[Andor Season 2|''Andor ''Season 2]] episode "[[Make It Stop]]"<ref name="MIS" /> released on [[May 13]], [[2025]] as part of the final block of episodes of [[Star Wars: Andor|the series]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> They were portrayed by [[Finney Cassidy]].<ref name="MIS" />
